message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each 1‑9, one 0) and two of each action card:
• Skip
• Reverse
• Draw Two
• Wild
• Wild Draw Four | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card face‑up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Turn Order** | Players sit around the table. The first turn goes to the player left of the dealer. Turn order moves clockwise unless a Reverse card changes it. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard. If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes direction of play.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. **(Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you can be challenged.)** | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card, shout “UNO!” If you forget and another player catches you before the next player takes a turn, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Continuing Play** | After a round, shuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile and deal again. Keep playing rounds until someone reaches the target score. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep a mix of colors** – it gives you more options to play. 2. **Save Wild Draw Four** for when you’re stuck; it can end a round quickly. 3. **Watch opponents’ “UNO” calls** – they’re a hint that they’re close to winning. 4. **Use Reverse strategically** – in a 2‑player game it’s a skip; in 3+ players it changes direction. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
